gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules print other financing receipts inside 'Local' receipts: General Fund Local 1,062,325 (p10) = Local 1,055,019 (p7) + Sale of surplus 7,306; Road Fund Local 129,527 (p12) = Local 39,411 + Insurance proceeds 11,599 + Sale of surplus 78,517 (p5). The governmental funds statement (p5-6) prints Insurance proceeds 11,599 and Sale of surplus 7,306 + 78,517 = 85,823 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (total 97,422), outside TOTAL RECEIPTS 10,620,074 (JSON other_financing 97,422). 10,717,496 - 97,422 = 10,620,074. Both printed classifications; no line missing or duplicated.
